summary: Updates RFC 8410 to clarify existing semantics and add missing ones for the key usage bits in certificates supporting the Ed25519, Ed448, X25519, and X448 elliptic curve algorithms. It is a standards-track specification.

eli5.summary: A certificate says what a key may be used for, like signing or locking. This clears up confusing wording for four modern key types so everyone reads the labels the same way.

questions: what key usage bits should ed25519 certificates have
how to set key usage for x25519 certificates
